title: Weather Dashboard
description: Build a weather dashboard that fetches mock data, displays current conditions, toggles between Fahrenheit and Celsius, shows a forecast, and supports city search.

steps.title: Fetch mock weather data
steps.description: Write a `getWeatherData` function that returns a mock weather object with `city`, `temperature`, `conditions`, `humidity`, and `windSpeed`. Log the data.
hints: Return an object: { city: 'London', temperature: 72, conditions: 'Sunny', humidity: 55, windSpeed: 10 }
The temperature is in Fahrenheit by default
Log the object to verify all fields are present

verification.successMessage: Weather data object has all required fields!
verification.failureMessage: getWeatherData should return an object with city, temperature, conditions, humidity, and windSpeed.

steps.title: Render current conditions
steps.description: Write a `renderCurrentWeather` function that takes a weather data object and logs a formatted string: `"London | 72°F | Sunny | Humidity: 55% | Wind: 10 mph"`.
hints: Access each field: data.city, data.temperature, data.conditions
Use template literals for clean formatting: `${data.city} | ${data.temperature}°F`
Include all fields in a single string

verification.successMessage: Current weather conditions display in a clean format!
verification.failureMessage: renderCurrentWeather should display city, temperature with °F, conditions, humidity, and wind speed.

steps.title: Toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius
steps.description: Write a `convertTemp` function that takes a temperature in Fahrenheit and a target unit (`'F'` or `'C'`). If `'C'`, convert using `(°F - 32) * 5/9` and round to the nearest integer. Log both values.
hints: If unit is 'F', return the temperature as-is
Use Math.round() to round the Celsius result
Log the converted temperature with the degree symbol

verification.failureMessage: convertTemp(72, 'F') should return 72, convertTemp(72, 'C') should return 22.

steps.title: Render the 5-day forecast
steps.description: Write a `renderForecast` function that takes an array of day objects with `day`, `high`, `low`, and `conditions`. Log each day in the format `"Mon: 72°F / 55°F - Sunny"`.
hints: Each day: { day: 'Mon', high: 72, low: 55, conditions: 'Sunny' }
Loop through the array and format each day's data

verification.successMessage: 5-day forecast renders with high/low temps and conditions!
verification.failureMessage: renderForecast should display each day with high, low, and conditions in the specified format.

steps.title: Search for a city
steps.description: Write a `searchCity` function that takes a city name, returns mock weather data for that city, and calls `renderCurrentWeather` on it. Log the rendered output.
hints: Create a mock data object for the searched city
Build a data object with the city name and sample values
Call renderCurrentWeather with the new data

verification.successMessage: City search returns and renders weather data for any city! Your dashboard is complete.
verification.failureMessage: searchCity should create a WeatherData object with the given city name and pass it to renderCurrentWeather.
